english: Yeah, I heard from the others that you really made the difference there.  Here's a small token of White River's appreciation.
Head into the city and find [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-][-] then clear out those flesh eating walking meat sacks. Be careful we don't want to lose another White River citizen...

Time to see if you have what it takes to be a part of White River Runners. Some of our guys at [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-][-] ran into some zombies im going to need you clear out those zombies and see if our guys are still holding out.
Head into the city and clear out those zombies.
I almost can't believe my eyes. You really managed to pull through in a pinch. Thanks for killing all those zombies. Here's what I owe ya.
Head into the city and go to [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-][-] there you will be a shipment with a White River marking on the side. Grab it. Be careful we don't know what's in there.
John, one of our White River special ops, had to stash his shipment at [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-][-]. Go retrieve the shipment and return it.
Bring back the shipment before John comes for my head.
Oh! It's you again, figured you'd be zombie chow by now. Not sure how you got out of that one but thanks for retrieving those supplies. Here's what I owe ya.
Go into the city and locate [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] then take care of the zombie problem, but keep an eye out for the missing book.

Have you ever heard of a place called [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-]? Some real bad stuff went down there involving Duke, and that was before the zombies came in. Guess where I need you to clear out? There's a book I'm looking for...
Take care of the zombies and look for the missing book.
Well, I'll be a monkey's uncle - you're alive! Unless you're a ghost or a zombie, but you don't look like either. And you have my book! Let me get you some money.
There's a missing shipment that someone is looking for - it was last seen near [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-].

Ugh, not you again. Well, maybe it's a good thing you are here - I need help with something. I was expecting a shipment of goods 'bout a week ago, but the courier never arrived. Will you go to [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] and see what's what?
Go to [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] and look for the missing shipment.
Hot diggity damn, you're back and just in time! Stock was running low here. I guess I owe you a little something, hmm? Hold on, I'll be right back.
Although [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] was abandoned by humans long ago, there are zombies there we need to clear.

Hey stranger, fancy seeing you 'round these parts. Are you available for a job? I would pay top dollar to see [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] cleared of zombies. You know the rate I'm willing to pay, so have fun hunting.
Head into the city, find [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-], and eliminate the zombies.
You're back, and right on time, too...didn't even break a sweat, did ya? I know I can always count on you...here's what was promised.
There are supplies at [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] that we need ASAP.

Do you believe in miracles? Because I am in need of one, and you walking through the door seems like no coincidence. I need some supplies at [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] or else the good people of the White River Settlement will suffer, and nobody wants that.
Locate [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] and retrieve the supplies that the trader is looking for.
Good night in the morning! You're back already? I figured you'd be at least a few more hours. Nevermind that...it looks like you have what I asked for; nice work. How does some cold, hard cash sound?
Locate [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] and take care of the bandit problem.

Hey there cowboy; long time no see. You got a few minutes and want something to do? A buncha dirtbags are holed up near [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] and have been giving me grief...think you can take care of them for me?
Go to the bandit hideout near [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] and clear out the raiders.
If you isn't a sight for sore eyes, and none the worse for wear, it seems. And about that payment...you prefer the money that folds and not the money that jingles, I've heard.
Go into [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] and look for the medical supplies that a sick child needs.

What's up hoss! Always glad to see your shadow darken my door. Can I trouble you for a spell? We got a sick kid at the White River Settlement and there are antibiotics in [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] that could be mighty useful. Don't worry, though, this isn't some charity case - top dollar if you make it back.
Locate the medical supplies in [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] and bring them back for a reward.
Thank God you're back - poor kiddo took a turn for the worse, so those meds are going to save her life. How does it feel to be a hero? The grateful parents left this wad of dough for you.
Zombies living near [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] need to be cleared out.

Glad to see you, my friend. You busy at the moment? There's a little infestation problem that's making life difficult for some rural folk, and they'd like to see the woods zombie-free. How does cash sound?
Head to [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] in the woods and finish off the zombies.
Very happy to see you again, and in one piece, too. Yeah, I've already heard about what you've done - people can't contain their joy, and word travels fast. Here's what I owe you, so thanks again.
There are some blueprints near [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] that a trader needs.

I've got a special job for you today if you've got the sack for it. You ever hear of Duke? Course you have. Well, rumor has it that some personal belongings of his - some valuable blueprints - were lost, and he asked me to hire my top guy for the job. You in?
Go to [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] and bring back the blueprints that Duke wants.

And here you are, right on time. And you've got the blueprints! Man, Duke is going to be thrilled once he hears about what you've done. I'll put in a good word for you with the boss man; not that you'll need it. Expect more gigs in the future!
Some mutated zombies near [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] need to be exterminated. The seem to be infected with a virus that is making them act crazy...

Thank goodness you walked in! We have a major crisis on our hands that needs dealing with. There's some sorta mutation spreading around the zombies, makes 'em real aggressive-like, and we gotta nip this little flu in the bud or else! Take 'em all out and come back here when you're done.
Go to [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] and kill off the mutated zombies.

It's a good thing you took care of them sick zombies when you did, because if it had gotten any worse, I don't know what we would have done. Here is what I owe ya - fingers crossed I won't be hiring you for the same kinda job any time soon.
Head out towards [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] and bring back missing supplies or else the shop might go out of business.

Just who I was looking for - you psychic or something? A really important shipment I was waiting on hasn't arrived, and I think it got lost in the wilderness. I need it, or else I might go bust - can you help?
Locate [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] and bring back the supplies to the store.
You have no idea how much this means to me...I really owe you one, cowboy. Here is what I promised and a little extra on top as a thank you. See you sometime soon, I hope?
There's an abandoned logging site near [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] that some lumberjack zombies have taken over?!

Bro! You're here, just in the nick of time. Zombies have taken over a section of the forest and are attacking anyone that heads near the woods - can you take 'em out before things get worse? You know what I'll pay you when you're done.
Head towards [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] and kill every zombie that you can find.

Welcome back, kind stranger! I can see that you've taken care of what I asked you to - atta boy! And in record time, it looks like...here, take this money and try not to spend it all in one place, unless it's here.
Go to the wooded site near [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] and find the missing magazines.

Blah...today's a bad day. I, uh, have some really special magazines that I keep in the woods, but I haven't been able to find them. Do you mind grabbing them for me? Just don't go looking through them - I'll be able to tell.
Find the place near [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] where the magazines are and bring them back.
You're back! I was starting to get worried, but maybe you're more competent than you look. Nevermind all of that - here's some money; now give me my magazines. Hey, you bent one of the edges! Grrr...
We have been asked to go to [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] and take care of any hostiles that we encounter.

Hey there chief, what's cracking? You gotta minute to rap with me? I need some help with some aggros that are holed up in the woods - bastards keep taking potshots at my store and I'm getting tired of running for cover. I'll pay you for a job well done.
Find the bandit hideout near [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] and take care of business.
I'm happy to see you've returned, my friend - doesn't seem like you had any problem with the bad guys either. Here's what I owe ya - stop by again sometime and we'll crack open a brew together.
Travel deep into the woods, out near [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-], and bring back the supplies that are needed.

Good day to you, my famous friend. Yeah, I said famous! Everyone know's you as a do-gooder around here, and speaking of which, I have a job for you. Can you bring back a missing shipment? My buddy was being chased by zombies and ditched a crate in the woods that I need.
Go to [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] and keep your eyes peeled for the missing supplies.
Bro, if you aren't a sight for sore eyes...and with the crate! My man. Shoulda hired you from the very beginning. Here, take this money and my thanks, and I'll see you soon, I hope.
Go into the city and locate [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] then take care of the zombie problem, but keep an eye out for the missing book.

A White River flag from a trader's build kit. Plant it at the site of a Build and Defend or Last Stand quest to start the build. Planted in the wrong spot? Pick it up and plant it again.
The Duke's banner from a Create Outpost kit. Hang it inside the quest's building to claim it as an outpost. If it's destroyed or taken down, the outpost falls.
The flag from a Safehouse quest. Hang it where you want the refugees' safehouse: everything the safehouse needs has to be within 10 blocks of it.
Get ready! Wave {0} of {1} arrives in {2} seconds.
Wave cleared! Wave {0} of {1} arrives in {2} seconds.
The rest of the wave falls back.
You held the line! Head back to the trader.
The bounty is holed up somewhere inside. Hunt it down!
The bounty is dead! Grab its loot.
Something's coming... The horde is here in {2} seconds!
The rest of the horde scatters.
The horde is dead! Head back to the trader.
Wave {0} of {1} is here, and it brought a boss!
The horde is here, and its leader with it!
Not here. Pick the flag up and plant it closer to the marker (an outpost banner goes inside the building).
Build your defenses! The zombies come in {0} minutes.
The zombies come in {0} seconds! Get to your defenses.
{0} waves held. Leave to bank them, or stay
You walked away with {0} waves banked. Head back to the trader for your pay.
You fled in the middle of a wave and lost everything.
You left before holding a single wave.
Hold the line as long as you dare! Wave 1 arrives in {2} seconds.
Wave {0} is here, and it brought a boss!
Wave held! Leave now to bank your pay, or stay for wave {0} in {2} seconds.
XP and dukes for every wave you hold
The blood moon brings {3} bosses, and they're coming for you!
A boss wave is down! There's more to come.
Every boss is dead! Collect your bounty from the trader.
You died. The bounty is lost.
The outpost is yours! The first attack comes in {3} hours. Be here when it does.
The outpost will be attacked within {3} hours! Get there and get ready.
The attack on the outpost is minutes away!
The attack is here! Hold the outpost: night {0} of {1}.
Bandits are raiding the outpost! Hold it: night {0} of {1}.
The outpost held tonight! {3} more nights to go.
The outpost held! Head back to the trader.
Nobody was at the outpost when the attack came. The outpost has fallen.
The outpost was attacked while you were away. It has fallen.
The banner is gone. The outpost has fallen.
Clear out [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-], then hold it against the zombies that come for it. Don't leave the area until it's over.
White River wants to use [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] as a waypoint for the runners, but the dead keep coming back to it. Clear it out, then hold it until they stop coming.
Clear the building and hold it against the waves.
You held it? Good. The runners will have a safe place to rest now. Here's your pay, you earned every bit of it.
[DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] is crawling with them. Clear out the infestation, then hold the building against the zombies that come for it. Don't leave the area until it's over.
There's a nest of the dead in [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-], and every one in the area is drawn to it. Burn the nest out, then hold the place until the rest of them stop coming.
Clear the infested building and hold it against the waves.
You cleaned out that nest and lived to tell me about it? I'm impressed. Here, take your pay.
A nasty one is holed up in [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-]. Clear the building, kill the bounty and come back for your pay. It'll have something worth taking on it.
There's a big one holed up in [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-], and it's already taken out two of my runners. I'm putting a bounty on it. Clear the place, kill it, and whatever it's carrying is yours.
Clear the building and kill the bounty.
It's dead? Ha! That's one less monster between my runners and their deliveries. Here's your bounty.
A horde has been roaming the area marked on your map. Go there and wipe it out, its leader too.
A horde's been roaming out past town, and something big is leading it. Head out there, draw them in, and put every last one of them down.
Find the horde and kill all of it.
The whole horde? Now that's a good day's work. Here's your bounty.

Take the supply kit to the marked site and plant the White River flag. You'll have 5 minutes to build defenses around it, then hold it against the waves. You can leave to gather supplies while you build, but don't leave once the zombies come.
White River needs an outpost out in the wild. Here's a supply kit and a flag. Plant the flag, build what you can around it, and hold it when the dead come to see what all the noise is about.
Plant the flag, fortify it and hold it against the waves.
The flag's still flying? Then that outpost is ours. Good work, here's your pay.

Clear out [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-], then use the supply kit to fortify it. You'll have 5 minutes to build, then you have to hold it against a big horde. You can leave to gather supplies while you build, but don't leave once the zombies come.
I want [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] turned into a stronghold. Clear it out, fortify it with this kit, and hold it. Fair warning: every dead thing for miles is going to come knocking.
Clear the building, fortify it and hold it against the horde.
You held it against all of that? You're one tough survivor. Here's your pay, and then some.
Hold as Long as You Dare

Take the supply kit to the marked site and plant the White River flag. Build for 5 minutes, then hold the flag against wave after wave, each worse than the last. Walk away during a break to bank your pay for every wave you held; each wave pays more than the last. Flee during a wave, or die, and you get nothing.
I've got a wager for you. Plant this flag out in the wild and hold it as long as you can stand it. I'll pay for every wave you survive, more for each one. Quit while you're ahead... or don't.
Plant the flag and hold it as long as you dare.
Still breathing? Then let's settle up. Here's your cut for every wave you held.
When the next blood moon rises, bosses will come for you wherever you are. Kill every one of them without dying, however long it takes, then come back for the bounty.
The blood moon's almost here, and the big ones come out with it. I'll pay a bounty on every one of them you put down. Don't worry about finding them. They'll find you.
Survive the blood moon and kill every boss that comes for you.
Blood Moon Bounty (the next blood moon)
You made it through the night and took them all down? That's a bounty well earned.

Clear out [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-], then hang the Duke's banner inside to make it an outpost. Every night at 22:00 the dead will attack it, more of them each night. You're free to leave during the day, but someone has to be there when an attack comes, and the banner has to survive it.
The Duke wants [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] for an outpost. Clear it, hang his banner, and hold it for a few nights while it gets established. The dead will come every night, and more of them each time.
Clear the building, hang the banner and hold the outpost.
The outpost held? The Duke will be pleased. Here's your pay, and plenty of it.
Clear, Fortify and Hold the Infestation

Clear the infestation out of [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-], then use the supply kit to fortify it. You'll have 5 minutes to build, then you have to hold it against a big horde. You can leave to gather supplies while you build, but don't leave once the zombies come.
[DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] is infested, and I want it anyway. Clear the nest out, fortify the place with this kit, and hold it against everything that comes for it.
Clear the infested building, fortify it and hold it against the horde.
Infested and swarmed, and you still held it? I don't know how you do it. Here's your pay, every bit of it earned.
Tier 3 Infested Clear, Build and Defend
Tier 4 Infested Clear, Build and Defend
Tier 5 Infested Clear, Build and Defend
Tier 6 Infested Clear, Build and Defend
The people this quest is about are gone (the mod that added them isn't loaded). It can't go on.
The bandits know you're here. Watch the windows!
The last bandit is down! Head back to the trader.
Lead them to the trader: {0}/{1} saved, {2} lost
The survivors are under siege somewhere inside! Break through to them.
Bandits are holding the survivors somewhere inside! Take them out.
Bandits have the survivors, and the dead are closing in on all of them! Get in there.
The attack is broken! Find the survivors and walk up to each one to lead them out.
More are coming! Keep the survivors moving.
A survivor made it to safety! {3} of {1} saved.
Everyone left is safe. Talk to the trader.
Every survivor is dead. The rescue has failed.
XP and dukes for every survivor saved
(or {0} dukes if your party has taken them all)
Hang the safehouse flag where you want it
Build it around the flag. Still needs: {0}
Lead the refugees home from the trader: {0}/{1} moved in
Build the refugees a home around the flag. The quest log shows what it still needs.
The safehouse is ready! The refugees will wait just outside the trader's compound. Walk up to them to lead them home.
The refugees are here, just outside the compound. Walk up to each one to lead them home.
A refugee moved in. {3} of {1} settled.
Everyone's moved in. The dead will come for the safehouse tonight, in about {3} hours. Be there.
The safehouse will be attacked within {3} hours! Get there and get ready.
The attack on the safehouse is minutes away!
The dead are here! Keep the refugees alive.
The safehouse held! The refugees will keep it going. Head back to the trader.
Nobody was at the safehouse when the attack came. It's been overrun.
The safehouse was attacked while you were away. It's been overrun.
Every refugee is dead. The safehouse has failed.
Bandits have taken over [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-]. Go in and kill every one of them. They shoot back, so use cover. You don't have to clear out the dead in there, just the bandits.
A bandit crew has holed up in [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-], and they've been hitting my runners on the road. Go in there and put an end to it. Every last one of them.
Kill every bandit in the building.
That crew won't be bothering anyone again. Here's your pay.

A group of survivors is trapped in [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-] and under attack. Break the attack, then lead the survivors back here: walk up to each one and they'll follow you. You're paid more for every one who makes it.
Some survivors got a call out from [DECEA3]{poi.name}[-]. They're pinned down, and they won't last long. Get them out of there and bring them here. As many as you can.
Break the attack and lead the survivors to the trader.
You brought them in. They'll be all right now, thanks to you. Here's your pay.

Hang the safehouse flag where you want the refugees to live and build them a home around it; the quest log shows what it still needs. Then lead the refugees there from the trader and hold the safehouse with them through its first night.
I've got refugees here with nowhere to go. Build them a safehouse, wherever you like, and get them settled in. The dead will come for it the first night, so be ready.
Build the safehouse, lead the refugees there and hold it through the night.
They've got a roof over their heads, and they held it. That's more than most get these days. Here's your pay.
Craft the order and bring it back.
That's exactly what I asked for. White River thanks you - here's your payment.
Cook a batch of rations over a campfire and bring them to the trader.
Our runners are living off cold cans out there. Cook up some proper rations over a fire and bring them to me, and I'll make it worth your while.
Smelt the order at a forge and bring it to the trader.
Duke's work crews are short on metal again. Fire up a forge, make what's on this list, and bring it to me.
Mix the order at a chemistry station and bring it to the trader.
The settlement's workshops are running dry on powder and glue. Mix up a batch at a chemistry station and bring it back here.
